title: Construct weapons
desc: Six construct weapons (bow, shield, spear, whip, chain, gauntlet), each forming pixel by pixel from the ring and then used on a dummy; J picked "more construct weapons".

takes.name: Bow
takes.facts: 13-piece arc, glowing string; forms in the left hand, arrow at the ring; draw, hold, loose; hit tick 48; forms from the ring ticks 1-20; dummy 6 blocks ahead

takes.name: Shield
takes.facts: hex shield (37 tiles) on the ring forearm; guard up, a shot breaks on it, shield flashes; hit tick 43; forms from the ring ticks 1-20; dummy 6 blocks ahead

takes.name: Spear
takes.facts: 1.8 blocks; step-thrust then overhand throw that sticks; hit ticks 36, 58; forms from the ring ticks 1-20; dummy 6 blocks ahead

takes.name: Whip
takes.facts: 16 links; wound back, lashed forward, the wave cracks at the dummy; hit tick 44; forms from the ring ticks 1-20; dummy 6 blocks ahead

takes.name: Chain
takes.facts: 12 links; swung overhead twice, thrown, wraps the dummy, pulled back; hit tick 52; forms from the ring ticks 1-20; dummy 6 blocks ahead

takes.name: Gauntlet
takes.facts: fist 2.2x the hand grows over it; wind up, step-punch, shock ring; hit tick 32; forms from the ring ticks 1-20; dummy 6 blocks ahead
